observed_anomalies.policy: Out of documented range: preserve raw data; expose unavailable with a diagnostic, never clamp to 100.

sampling_limitations: Not complete replay fixtures: one driver per main telemetry window; two drivers in supplementary qualifying checks.
Full drivers/race_control/weather/pit queries; driver 4 laps/position/stints; bounded car_data/location/intervals queries.
Inspection hashes identify raw HTTP response bytes; upstream records can change, so re-fetching may produce different hashes.
HTTP 404 means no successful dataset was returned for the exact query; it is not a universal feature-availability conclusion.
Raw acquisitions and raw performance samples are retained externally, not committed as bulk provider data.

geometry_policy.observed: Meeting metadata links a separate MultiViewer circuit-information service; both year/circuit endpoints returned coordinates.
geometry_policy.requirement: Validate circuit/year/meeting identity and a shared transform against telemetry before rendering an observed track map.
geometry_policy.not_verified: Coordinate calibration, lateral precision, geometry redistribution permissions and a native OpenF1 outline endpoint.
geometry_policy.fallback: Map unavailable; timing continues. Never substitute a circle or unrelated circuit.
